author: Bob Chirello
text: Thank you for always being there when we need you at the Catholic Center. You have done all types of repairs. Prompt, courteous  service and always give us options to consider. Thanks for the referral to Chandler Design Group. They did a great job of the mitigation and reconstruction work.

author: Alexander Bush
text: Advanced Plumbing is far and away the best plumbing company I have ever worked with. They are quick to arrive, extremely knowledgeable, and their professionalism is above and beyond. They are the only company I will use.

author: Donna Bell
text: I cannot say enough good things about this company.  Kelsey, Colin, Jacob and Westley were all extremely knowledgeable and were able to quickly determine what needed to be done to eliminate my problem.  I am so thankful that they were recommended to me,  and I want to pass that recommendation on to anyone else who may have need for a plumber.

author: Kelly Howard
text: There is no other plumbing company in the Northeast Georgia region that outperforms Advanced Plumbing in quality of service, professionalism, timeliness, and all-around positive customer experience. If I could give them 6 stars I would. A++

author: FT Georgia
text: Had an unusual & complex septic issue that was challenging to diagnose & resolve. Kelsey Davis & team were superb in technical & communication skills, acting as communication lead w/county & recommending other needed contractors. I would not have gotten through this complex problem without Kelsey as project lead. I’ve used Advanced for 10 years, but I can’t fully express how grateful I am & how much respect I have for Kelsey after this recent challenge. Previously they did smaller jobs like toilet replacement & service was just as excellent, but I highly recommend for larger projects as well.
